summary: Tested guest play/skip limit functionality. All features working correctly: play count increments, skip count increments, login modal appears at limit (5), limits work independently of billing settings, and guestLimitReached flag is set to stop playback when current song ends.

guest_play_limit.details: Play count increments from 0 to 5, login modal appears at 5 plays
console_logs: [Guest] Play limit reached - showing prompt and BLOCKING autoplay

guest_skip_limit.details: Skip count increments from 0 to 5, login modal appears at 5 skips, further skips are BLOCKED
console_logs: [Guest] Skip limit reached - showing prompt and BLOCKING autoplay

billing_independence.details: Guest limit functions (checkGuestPlayLimit, incrementGuestPlayCount, incrementGuestSkipCount) do NOT check billingEnabled - limits are always enforced for guests

playback_stop_on_song_end.details: player.setGuestLimitReached(true) is called when limit reached, which sets guestLimitReachedRef in useAudioPlayer.js to stop autoplay when current song ends

login_modal.details: GuestLimitModal appears with 'Kufurahia Huduma Hii' (Enjoy Full Access) message and 'Ingia / Jisajili' (Sign In / Register) button

critical_code_review_comments: Guest limit implementation is correct and independent of billing
GUEST_PLAY_LIMIT=5 and GUEST_SKIP_LIMIT=5 are properly enforced
guestLimitReachedRef in useAudioPlayer.js correctly stops autoplay in handleSongEnd
